verdict.title: All clear
verdict.text: No meaningful cluster of credit or debt stress. Conditions look healthy.

categories.title: Credit availability
categories.question: Are banks making it harder to borrow?

indicators.name: Banks tightening business loan standards
indicators.series_title: Net Percentage of Domestic Banks Tightening Standards for Commercial and Industrial Loans to Large and Middle-Market Firms
indicators.release_name: Senior Loan Officer Opinion Survey on Bank Lending Practices
indicators.thresholds: Yellow at 10 or higher, red at 30 or higher
indicators.why: Net share of banks tightening standards on loans to large and mid-size firms. Readings above ~30% have preceded most recessions.

indicators.name: Banks tightening credit card standards
indicators.series_title: Net Percentage of Domestic Banks Tightening Standards for Credit Card Loans
indicators.release_name: Senior Loan Officer Opinion Survey on Bank Lending Practices
indicators.thresholds: Yellow at 10 or higher, red at 25 or higher
indicators.why: Net share of banks tightening standards on credit cards: an early read on household credit access.

categories.title: Debt-service pressure
categories.question: Are debt payments eating a bigger share of income?

indicators.name: Household debt service ratio (1-yr change)
indicators.series_title: Household Debt Service Payments as a Percent of Disposable Personal Income
indicators.thresholds: Yellow at 0.2 or higher, red at 0.5 or higher
indicators.why: Required household debt payments as a share of disposable income. A sustained rise means debt is squeezing budgets.

categories.title: Credit spreads & financial conditions
categories.question: Are lenders demanding more to take risk?

indicators.name: High-yield bond spread
indicators.series_title: ICE BofA US High Yield Index Option-Adjusted Spread
indicators.thresholds: Yellow at 4.5 or higher, red at 6 or higher
indicators.why: Extra yield investors demand to hold junk bonds over Treasuries. Sharp widening signals lenders pulling back from riskier borrowers.

indicators.name: Investment-grade bond spread
indicators.series_title: ICE BofA US Corporate Index Option-Adjusted Spread
indicators.thresholds: Yellow at 1.3 or higher, red at 2 or higher
indicators.why: Extra yield on high-quality corporate bonds. Widening here means stress is spreading beyond the weakest borrowers.

indicators.name: Chicago Fed financial conditions
indicators.series_title: Chicago Fed National Financial Conditions Index
indicators.release_name: Chicago Fed National Financial Conditions Index
indicators.thresholds: Yellow at -0.25 or higher, red at 0 or higher
indicators.why: Broad measure of credit, risk and leverage conditions. Above 0 means tighter than average.

categories.title: Credit growth vs. income
categories.question: Is borrowing slowing relative to the economy?

indicators.name: Bank loan growth (1-yr)
indicators.series_title: Loans and Leases in Bank Credit, All Commercial Banks
indicators.release_name: H.8 Assets and Liabilities of Commercial Banks in the United States
indicators.thresholds: Yellow at 2 or lower, red at 0 or lower
indicators.why: Year-over-year growth in total bank loans. Shrinking credit is a hallmark of deleveraging.

indicators.name: Bank loan growth minus nominal GDP growth
indicators.series_title: Loans and Leases in Bank Credit, All Commercial Banks
indicators.release_name: H.8 Assets and Liabilities of Commercial Banks in the United States
indicators.thresholds: Yellow at 0 or lower, red at -4 or lower
indicators.why: When credit grows slower than incomes, the economy is paying debt down relative to income.

indicators.name: Private debt to GDP (1-yr change)
indicators.series_title: Total Credit to Private Non-Financial Sector, Adjusted for Breaks, for United States
indicators.thresholds: Yellow at -0.5 or lower, red at -3 or lower
indicators.why: BIS measure of private non-financial debt relative to GDP. A falling ratio means deleveraging is underway (lags by a few quarters).

categories.title: Delinquencies
categories.question: Are borrowers falling behind on payments?

indicators.name: Credit card delinquency rate (1-yr change)
indicators.series_title: Delinquency Rate on Credit Card Loans, All Commercial Banks
indicators.release_name: Charge-Off and Delinquency Rates on Loans and Leases at Commercial Banks
indicators.thresholds: Yellow at 0.2 or higher, red at 0.5 or higher
indicators.why: Change in the share of credit card balances 30+ days past due.

indicators.name: All-loan delinquency rate (1-yr change)
indicators.series_title: Delinquency Rate on All Loans, All Commercial Banks
indicators.release_name: Charge-Off and Delinquency Rates on Loans and Leases at Commercial Banks
indicators.thresholds: Yellow at 0.1 or higher, red at 0.3 or higher
indicators.why: Change in the delinquency rate across all bank loans: shows whether stress is broadening.

indicators.name: Commercial real estate delinquency (1-yr change)
indicators.series_title: Delinquency Rate on Commercial Real Estate Loans (Excluding Farmland), Booked in Domestic Offices, All Commercial Banks
indicators.release_name: Charge-Off and Delinquency Rates on Loans and Leases at Commercial Banks
indicators.thresholds: Yellow at 0.2 or higher, red at 0.5 or higher
indicators.why: Change in delinquencies on commercial real estate loans (excluding farmland).

categories.title: Spending, income & jobs
categories.question: Is debt stress reaching the real economy?

indicators.name: Sahm rule recession indicator
indicators.thresholds: Yellow at 0.3 or higher, red at 0.5 or higher
indicators.why: Rise in the 3-month average unemployment rate vs. its prior-year low. 0.5+ has marked the start of every recession since 1970.

indicators.name: Job growth (3-month average)
indicators.thresholds: Yellow at 75 or lower, red at 0 or lower
indicators.why: Average monthly change in nonfarm payrolls over the last three months.

indicators.name: Real disposable income (1-yr)
indicators.thresholds: Yellow at 1.5 or lower, red at 0 or lower
indicators.why: Inflation-adjusted after-tax income growth. Falling income makes debt harder to carry.

indicators.name: Real consumer spending (1-yr)
indicators.thresholds: Yellow at 1.5 or lower, red at 0 or lower
indicators.why: Inflation-adjusted consumer spending growth. Cutbacks confirm debt stress is biting.

indicators.name: Yield curve (10-yr minus 3-month)
indicators.series_title: 10-Year Treasury Constant Maturity Minus 3-Month Treasury Constant Maturity
indicators.thresholds: Yellow at 0.5 or lower, red at 0 or lower
indicators.why: Longer-lead recession warning: inversion (below 0) has preceded recessions, though with false alarms and long lags.
